caption:
Claude only reads the transcript of a video, so it misses half of what’s on screen.
 
One free GitHub repo fixes that. Type /watch, paste any YouTube, Instagram or TikTok link, and Claude breaks the video down shot by shot. Perfect for studying what makes a hook work.
 
Comment WATCH and I’ll send you the setup guide.
